rounding pi
```{r}
round(3.14159)
```
repeating numbers
```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))
```
repeating numbers again
```{r}
print(rep(x=5, times= 7))
```
types of variables
```{r}
#define variables
numeric_variable <- 5
character_variable <- "hello world"
logic_variable <- TRUE
#print variables and define their classes
print(numeric_variable)
print(class(numeric_variable))
print(character_variable)
print(class(character_variable))
print(logic_variable)
print(class(logic_variable))
```
